fields.rt-blog-html:
You were not present last Thursday or you want to see the exchanges again? It's here !

Prestigious speakers such as Nicolas Riché (CEO of Columbus Café), Julien Perret(CEO of BChef), Thomas Barenfeld (President of La Piadina France) and Samuel Burner (Editor-in-Chief of the Observatoire de la Franchise) were pleased to be present alongside our General Manager Romain Melloul to give us their opinions and feedback. Recruitment of franchisees, economic models to consider, life of a network...

Don't miss our next events: subscribe to our newsletter or follow us on LinkedIn !

‍
